requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility angle α of the front fog lamp shall be 5° upwards and downwards, as defined by paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.quote: Defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 5° upwards and downwards

requirements.text: The geometric visibility angle ß of the front fog lamp shall be 45° outwards and 10° inwards, as defined by paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.quote: ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp does not exceed 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be –1.0 per cent or lower.
requirements.quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is 0.8 m or less, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent.
requirements.quote: h ≤ 0.8 Limits: between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is 0.8 m or less, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent at initial aiming.
requirements.quote: Initial aiming: between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is greater than 0.8 m, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent.
requirements.quote: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is greater than 0.8 m, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent at initial aiming.
requirements.quote: Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the manufacturer shall specify the initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat within an accuracy of one decimal place.
requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial downward inclination of the cut-off shall be indicated on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate, or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1., by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial downward inclination of the cut-off shall be indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle.
requirements.quote: indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the value of the indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: The value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, the front fog lamp levelling device shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, remains between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: When the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.
requirements.quote: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.

requirements.text: Where the front fog beam inclination is automatically adapted in relation to the prevailing ambient conditions by the levelling device, the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. shall not be exceeded.
requirements.quote: provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded.

requirements.text: In the case of a failure of the front fog lamp levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut-off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.quote: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall be capable of being switched ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps

requirements.text: When the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part.
requirements.quote: The front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS; however, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall not be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol '/' according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19 or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].
requirements.quote: The front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol ("/") according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19. or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].

requirements.text: Where there is a positive indication in the communication form under item 'Luminous intensity is variable' of Annex 1 to UN Regulations Nos. 19 or 149, any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment of the front fog beam shall be performed automatically.
requirements.quote: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically

requirements.text: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment of the front fog beam shall be performed in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.
requirements.quote: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be mounted on all motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on all motor vehicles.

requirements.text: Where a trailer is over 1,600 mm wide, the front position lamp shall be mounted on that trailer.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.

requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be two in number, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the front position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: When the front position lamp is fitted to a trailer, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In the case of a trailer, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two front position lamp apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: Not less than 600 mm.

requirements.text: Where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm, the distance between the inner edges of the two front position lamp apparent surfaces may be reduced to 400 mm.
requirements.quote: This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be not more than 1,500 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp is installed on O1 or O2 category vehicles, the front position lamp shall be not more than 2,100 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: Where the shape of the bodywork of any other category of vehicle makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm, the front position lamp shall be not more than 2,100 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).
requirements.quote: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall provide a horizontal angle of 45° inwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall provide a horizontal angle of 80° outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: In the case of trailers, the inward angle of the front position lamp may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: In the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall provide a vertical angle of 15° above the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall provide a vertical angle of 15° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is an M1 or N1 category vehicle and a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp may be designed as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. with a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be oriented forwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Forwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the front position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, except that if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The front position lamp installation shall include a closed-circuit tell-tale.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the front position lamp shall be non-flashing.
requirements.quote: This tell-tale shall be non-flashing

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the front position lamp shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the front position lamp requirement shall not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: This requirement does not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: Where required by the component regulation, a tell-tale indicating failure shall be provided for the front position lamp.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: Where one or more infrared radiation generators are installed inside the front position lamp, the infrared radiation generators shall be allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.
requirements.quote: If one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, it (they) is (are) allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.

requirements.text: Where one or more infrared radiation generators are installed inside the front position lamp, the infrared radiation generators shall be automatically switched OFF in the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails.
requirements.quote: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the parking lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where there are two parking lamps, they shall be on the sides of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Furthermore, if there are two lamps, they shall be on the sides of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the parking lamp shall allow the parking lamp(s) on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.
requirements.quote: The connection shall allow the parking lamp(s) on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.

requirements.text: The parking lamp(s) and, if applicable, the front and rear position lamps according to paragraph 6.12.9. below, shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.quote: The parking lamp(s) and, if applicable, the front and rear position lamps according to paragraph 6.12.9. below, shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the parking lamp shall not include a device which automatically switches OFF these lamps as a function of time.
requirements.quote: A device which automatically switches OFF these lamps as a function of time is prohibited.

requirements.text: In width, the front end-outline marker lamp shall be as close as possible to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: Front and rear: as close as possible to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In width, the rear end-outline marker lamp shall be as close as possible to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: Front and rear: as close as possible to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall be deemed to meet the in-width requirement when the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: This condition is deemed to have been met when the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For motor vehicles, the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of the front end-outline marker lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not be lower than the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the transparent zone of the windscreen.
requirements.quote: Front: Motor vehicles - the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the device shall not be lower than the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the transparent zone of the wind-screen.

requirements.text: For trailers and semi-trailers, the front end-outline marker lamp shall be at the maximum height compatible with the requirements relating to the width, design and operational requirements of the vehicle and to the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.quote: Trailers and semi-trailers - at the maximum height compatible with the requirements relating to the width, design and operational requirements of the vehicle and to the symmetry of the lamps.

requirements.text: The rear end-outline marker lamp shall be at the maximum height compatible with the requirements relating to the width, design and operational requirements of the vehicle and to the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.quote: Rear: At the maximum height compatible with the requirements relating to the width, design and operational requirements of the vehicle and to the symmetry of the lamps.

requirements.text: The additional end-outline marker lamps, as specified in paragraph 6.13.2. (b), shall be fitted as far separated in height as practicable in respect to the mandatory ones, provided that their position is compatible with design/operational requirements of the vehicle and symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.quote: The additional lamps, as specified in paragraph 6.13.2. (b), shall be fitted as far separated in height as practicable in respect to the mandatory ones, provided that their position is compatible with design/operational requirements of the vehicle and symmetry of the lamps.

requirements.text: The additional end-outline marker lamps, as specified in paragraph 6.13.2. (a), shall be fitted as close as practicable to the rear.
requirements.quote: The additional lamps, as specified in paragraph 6.13.2. (a), shall be fitted as close as practicable to the rear;

requirements.text: The distance between the additional end-outline marker lamps and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 400 mm.
requirements.quote: this requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the distance between the additional lamps and the rear of the vehicle does not exceed 400 mm.

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 80° outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 5° above and 20° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 5° above and 20° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off of the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps shall be set to the plated figure as required and shown in Annex 7.
requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off of the dipped beam and the front fog lamps shall be set to the plated figure as required and shown in Annex 7.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer sets the initial aim to a figure different from the plated figure, that figure shall be shown to be representative of the type approved when tested in accordance with the procedures contained in Annex 6 and in particular paragraph 4.1.
requirements.quote: Alternatively, the manufacturer shall set the initial aim to a figure that is different from the plated figure where it can be shown to be representative of the type approved when tested in accordance with the procedures contained in Annex 6 and in particular paragraph 4.1.

requirements.text: The variation of the dipped-beam downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain within the mounting height limits given in the table in this paragraph.
requirements.quote: The variation of the dipped-beam downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain within the range: Mounting height h [m] Upper inclination limit [per cent] Lower inclination limit [per cent]

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp has light source(s) with a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2,000 lumens and h < 0.8, the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain at or above 0.7 per cent minimum vertical inclination.
requirements.quote: In the case of a front fog lamp with (a) light source(s) having a total objective luminous flux which exceeds 2,000 lumens, the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain within the range: h < 0.8: 0.7 per cent minimum vertical inclination

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp has light source(s) with a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2,000 lumens and h < 0.8, the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain at or below 3.3 per cent maximum vertical inclination.
requirements.quote: h < 0.8: 0.7 per cent minimum vertical inclination and 3.3 per cent maximum vertical inclination;

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp has light source(s) with a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2,000 lumens and h > 0.8, the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain at or above 1.2 per cent minimum vertical inclination.
requirements.quote: h > 0,8: 1.2 per cent minimum vertical inclination

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp has light source(s) with a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2,000 lumens and h > 0.8, the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain at or below 3.8 per cent maximum vertical inclination.
requirements.quote: and 3.8 per cent maximum vertical inclination.

requirements.text: The states of loading used shall be as indicated in Annex 5 of this Regulation, for every system adjusted accordingly.
requirements.quote: The states of loading to be used shall be as follows, as indicated in Annex 5 of this Regulation, for every system adjusted accordingly.

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: The category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: The lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.
requirements.quote: Lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations No. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations No. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so made that they give good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.
requirements.quote: and good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them.

requirements.text: Where the reflector and the diffusing lens of a unit cannot be separated, the lamp need not be fitted with an adjustment device, provided the use of such units is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.
requirements.quote: Such a device need not be fitted on units in which the reflector and the diffusing lens cannot be separated, provided the use of such units is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.

requirements.text: In case of headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and of front fog lamps, the lamps shall be so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.
requirements.quote: In case of headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and of front fog lamps, such a device may or may not provide horizontal adjustment, provided that the headlamps are so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.

requirements.quote: Front position lamps: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply.

requirements.text: If required by the provisions of the relevant UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, the device (lamp) shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant's selection of one or more of the following options.

requirements.text: Where option (a) is selected, the signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall indicate that one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light.
requirements.quote: (a) One or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light;

requirements.text: Where option (b) is selected, the signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall indicate that, as a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stopping emitting light, the resulting luminous intensity value in any of the photometric requirements is less than 80% of the minimum luminous intensity value required for the type approval.
requirements.quote: (b) As a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous intensity value in any of the photometric requirements is less than 80% of the minimum luminous intensity value required for the type approval;

requirements.text: Where option (c) is selected, the signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall indicate that, as a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stopping emitting light, the resulting luminous flux value has changed by more than 5% compared to the luminous flux value when no failure occurs.
requirements.quote: (c) As a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous flux value has changed by more than 5% compared to the luminous flux value when no failure occurs;

requirements.text: Where option (d) is selected, the signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall indicate that more than 5% of the elements for visible radiation stop emitting light.
requirements.quote: (d) More than 5% of the elements for visible radiation stop emitting light.

requirements.text: In case more than one light source is used, the signal provided under option (d) shall apply to the sum of all elements and to the elements of each light source separately.
requirements.quote: In case more than one light source is used, this provision applies to the sum of all elements and to the elements of each light source separately.

requirements.text: Where option (e) is selected and one or more UN approved light source(s) is fitted, the signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall indicate that one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.
requirements.quote: (e) If fitted, one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.
